verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a quickstart that gets flags 'running in your application in minutes' (a few lines of code), a free signup with no credit card, per-environment toggling including production, and a toggle endpoint. A hands-on user independently reports having flags working in about 15 minutes with under 10 lines of code. missing for 10: an explicit documented step-by-step for creating a flag in the UI, and live propagation of toggles evidenced only via Proxy streaming for JavaScript/React.
